messages:
noah: FYI i'm scheduling an unpin -> rollforward of runtime v3.3 -> v3.4 next Tue 03:00 UTC. This unpin includes kernel updates that affect quant-v5. Noting SDK 2.11 has the new decode ordering fix but only 60% of clients are on it. Need short compatibility plan before canary.

deploybot: Automated: plan=unpin-r3.4, target=runtime:v3.4, requester=noah, canary=8%, window=90m, fallback=runtime:v3.3. Plan-id=uf-7621.

tara: tagging infra: @devops-bot can you pre-warm pools and mark which hosts are still on quant-v5? We should avoid them for initial canary.

devops-bot: Pre-warm scheduled. Hosts with quant-v5 flagged: eu-west-1a, ap-south-1b. Routing tags added: avoid-quant-v5 for plan uf-7621.

ryan: Quick risk note: customers using text-search model group tend to hit long-context ranking where quant-v5 mismatch causes 503s. Suggest pinlist exception to keep text-search on v3.3 for 72h after rollout.

sophie: +1 on pin exception. Also recommend enabling the ordered-decode shim on v3.4 for first 3h; cost hit but safer.

harper (QE): I can run a focused regression against ranking prompts and long-context embeddings on a staging fleet without quant-v5. ETA 35m. Will post failing IDs if any.

noah: command we used in staging preflight (copy):
```
/deploybot unpin runtime=v3.4 --canary=8% --window=90m --fallback=runtime=v3.3 --plan=uf-7621
```

tara: If QE finds anything, we hold. Also add a metric to watch: decode-order-violation and backend-503-rate. Set abort threshold: decode-order-violation >3/min or 503-rate>0.4% -> pause and rollback.

harper (QE): Running tests now. Will also run a smoke matrix with SDK 2.10 and 2.11.

devops-bot: Telemetry hooks created for plan uf-7621. Subscriptions: #eng-releases, pager to ops on abort. Threshold rules applied.

ryan: Added temporary pinlist exception proposal: `/deploybot apply-pin-exception uf-7621 --target=text-search --runtime=v3.3 --duration=72h`

sophie: approving pin exception for text-search. Also request a note in changelog: "v3.4 introduces quant-v5 kernels; SDK 2.11 recommended; older SDKs may fallback automatically but expect higher p99."

harper (QE): regression update: ranking+long-context passes on non-quant hosts. On quant-v5 hosts we see sporadic 503s for prompt IDs: rank_204, rank_333. Recommend keeping quant-v5 hosts out of first 45m.

noah: ok plan adjusted: 8% canary to non-quant-v5 hosts only for first 45m. shim=ordered-decode:enabled(duration=3h). abort-rules as tara suggested. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unpin-v3.4-guidance

deploybot: Plan updated: canary-routing=avoid-quant-v5(45m), shim=ordered-decode(enabled,3h), abort=(decode-order>3/min || 503>0.4%). Pin exception queued for text-search.

sophie: I'll draft the public release note: mention SDK recommendation + pin exception for text-search + automatic fallback. Posting in #product-release-drafts shortly.

harper (QE): final check: regression including SDK 2.10 clients still shows graceful fallback to v3.3 for the failing prompts when routed, so outage risk is low. Two long-tail prompts show increased latency on v3.4 (ids: lag_77, lag_102). Marking as monitored.

tara: capacity note: ap-south-1b is low on spare GPUs tonight. Keep that region excluded from canary until 03:30Z.

noah: all thumbs? list: 1) QE pass (harper) 2) pin exception applied (ryan) 3) shim enabled (sophie) 4) routing adjustment (devops-bot) 5) runbook linked (noah).

sophie: 44d pinned exception applied, release note drafted.

harper (QE): 44d regressions ok with caveats, monitoring flagged.

devops-bot: 44d routing rules applied, ap-south excluded for initial window.

noah: initiating rollout per uf-7621. will post telemetry summaries and escalate if abort hits. thanks everyone. :rocket:
